text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Tomorrow is Valentine's.
I had made up my mind.
And that was—)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna... give Trainer
my chocolate!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(They do so much for me all the time.
I've gotta make sure I show my gratitude properly!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(What I'm making is "Fondant au Chocolat"!
Let's do this!
—Because everyone's cheering for me!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, Flash-san,
I'd really love it if you could teach me the recipe!”

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: When I asked Hishi Ama-san, she said it'd be best to ask Flash-san.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I see, I understand now.
Fondant au chocolat, is it...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Um, is it really too difficult?
Even so, I'd still like to try...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I can't really cook.
Even when melting chocolate and letting it set,
I used to have my mom help me.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Still, if I'm making it for you, Trainer,
I want to make something properly stylish
and delicious!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I will definitely make it a success in the end!
Please give me a chance...!"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry.
There's no need to be so tense—making chocolate fondant isn't that difficult.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "If anything, even a simplified recipe turns out delicious enough, and you can still make it look and taste rich, so it's quite suitable for beginners."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
!
Then...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Here, I'll give you a simplified recipe.
I hope your feelings reach them."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah, as expected of Flash.
Just as skilled as Fuji said.
With that recipe, even Yukino should find it easy to make.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I'm worried, so at first
I'd really appreciate Hishi Ama-san's help too...!”

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Of course I'll help out.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
“Still, are you sure?
I can lend a hand on the day of, too.”

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: No! I'm totally fine! I'll do my best on my own!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Is that so.
Well then, let's start prep first.
Could you crack the eggs for me?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes!
(Tap, tap... Crunch!!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah!?
The eggs are completely squashed!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...Give it your all, Yukino!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, this snowman pick is so cute!
Maybe I'll use it as a decoration~.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that could be really cute!
Maybe dusting some powdered sugar over the plate
would look great too?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I see, so it ends up lookin' like a snowy landscape!
Ooh~... decoratin' is pretty fun!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Just handing it over would be boring, so maybe playing shop like 'Yukino Cafe' would be fun!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh!
Incredible, Curren-san really is the best.
I'm so glad I worked up the courage to ask for your advice.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ Curren is always on the side
of girls who want to do their best!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
And then... I'll teach you a special
little spell for when you hand it over♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: A good luck charm?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yeah, well, you see—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder if I—
I can really pull off that good luck charm.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Nah, that can wait. First off,
I gotta make some delicious fondant au chocolat!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
All right!
I'm gonna do my best!
Today is Valentine's Day. Having been called out by Yukino Bijin, I arrived at the cafeteria, when...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, y'all!
Welcome to the Yukino Cafe~!

An impromptu skit began out of nowhere. I have no idea what she's trying to do,
but I decide to just watch and see how it plays out.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
You see, our shop
only serves a single item on the menu.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "That's my top recommendation, so what do you think...?"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Just a moment~!

What Yukino Bijin brought over was chocolate fondant on a plate.
It was adorably decorated.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Here is the "Snowy Fondant au Chocolat."
The chef poured her heart into making it.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Also, um,
there is a good luck charm, but...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...O-On second thought, never mind!
Um, please, go ahead and eat it!"

Cutting into the moist pastry with a knife,
warm, melted chocolate sauce flowed out from the inside.
Taking a bite, it was warmly, comforting sweet...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: W-What do you think...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: I want to express my gratitude for such an exquisite cake.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe.
Is that so~? It was delicious, was it~?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Um, actually...
The chef is right over here.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"No, thank you,
as always!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Also, um,
there is a good luck charm, but...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...D-Do your best, Yukino!
You gotta hit 'em hard right here!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: My heart!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Enjoy your meal... ♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Aaaah~~!!
I-I did it, Curren-san...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
P-Please have some while it's hot!

Cutting into the moist pastry with a knife,
warm, melted chocolate sauce flowed out from the inside.
Taking a bite, it was warmly, comforting sweet...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
!
Really?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Phew, what a relief~...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe...
I'm real glad you liked it.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
And so, to prepare for today,
I got a bunch of different folks to help me out.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "I'd like to thank everyone too, so would it be alright if I called them over after this?"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Thank you!
In that case...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Shall we start prepping the Yukino & Trainer Cafe for opening?
And so, Yukino Bijin's friends gathered as well... and a lively Valentine's Day passed by.
